data.title: Rejection of hunting license application (Jagdschein – Ablehnung)
data.summary: Kreis Musterdithmarschen (Fachdienst Waffen und Jagd) rejected Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license (Jagdschein) because his proof of hunting liability insurance expired on 30 June 2026. The authority states it will issue the license without a new application as soon as a valid insurance confirmation is submitted.
data.explanation: The authority cannot give you a hunting license right now because your proof of hunting liability insurance is no longer valid. The simplest step is to send a current insurance confirmation — then the license will be issued without you filing a new application. If you disagree with the rejection itself, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the authority; the app shows until when this is possible. If you do nothing, the rejection stands and no license will be issued until the missing insurance proof is provided.
